_readme: Nambikkai golden corpus. ALL values synthetic. Inputs carry a '~~' splitter inside sensitive-shaped tokens so this tracked file never contains a matchable identifier at rest; runners strip '~~' before testing. Groups: must_mask (guard must catch) / must_stay (guard must not touch) / known_overmatch (documented false-positive shapes — warn, never block) / known_gap (documented misses — honest debt, not hidden). Every incident in a deployment becomes a new case here.
